svg.text: Each service has its own service account: orchestrator = Firestore + publish + run.developer on the one target; analyst = Vertex AI + call MCP;

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: MCP = read logs/revisions; target = no permissions at all. No service-account keys, no allUsers binding, no project-level owner/editor.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The analyst's reply is untrusted (it reads log text an attacker may influence). It is parsed into a closed schema (rollback | none), then checked by code against LIVE Cloud Run state:

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: allow-listed service, target revision exists / ready / older. Anything else fails the run before a human is asked. A human approves the exact action; execution re-checks state and is idempotent.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before every step, even an approved one: per-run budget, platform daily spend cap, kill switch. A model that never called its tools is refused, and a failed A2A task is never read as an answer.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Steps are at-least-once: finished steps are checkpointed and never re-run; the lease has a heartbeat; the rollback is idempotent. Evidence strings are the model's words and are not cross-checked against logs.
